prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1466; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, restricted cervical range of motion, and muscle tension. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Over the course of 17 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical and expected progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms steadily improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly corroborate the diagnosis of cervical strain. The patient reports no known prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine. Billed services reflect the treatment rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
